protocol.question: does within-group label variation, not the data or the grouping, determine whether the repair can pass the dual gate?
protocol.design: one dataset, one feature matrix, one grouping; only the label changes, along a gradient of within-group variation
protocol.dataset: GSE316098 NanoString GeoMx DSP, cervix; 186 ROIs from 7 cases; each ROI carries its own pathology annotation
protocol.preprocessing: counts -> CPM(1e4) -> log1p -> top variable genes
protocol.note: cell_type is a nominal label; its tau sign depends on the arbitrary epi/stroma coding and is reported as-is.
